args.title: Lifecycle Operating Checklist — January 2028
args.body:
# Lifecycle Operating Checklist

## Routine non-state-changing send — Ines Kovac

- Ines Kovac confirms the send is routine, non-state-changing, within the three-send weekly ceiling, and uses an approved audience and template.
- Ines Kovac confirms current supported state, suppression results, merge-alias and destination checks, and no unresolved exception.
- Ines Kovac releases a clean send without case-by-case approval.
- Ines Kovac records the manifest, preflight evidence, release time, and disposition.
- Ines Kovac completes the row-level audit within 24 hours. An unfinished audit remains visibly open, and Ines Kovac makes no later routine release while an overdue audit remains open.

## Hold and escalation — Ines Kovac and Riley Tanaka

- Ines Kovac holds rows with missing, stale, unresolved, or conflicting required state; active Customer Success adoption or renewal work; suppression or alias conflicts; or any unclear audience, destination, or template result.
- Ines Kovac does not manually waive a hold or release an exception.
- Ines Kovac escalates preflight exceptions, disputed meanings, cross-surface discrepancies, state-changing work, and exception-heavy work to Riley Tanaka.
- Riley Tanaka decides disputed semantics, cross-surface consequences, customer corrections, incident stops, higher-risk work, and executive claims.
- Riley Tanaka keeps any customer correction or incident stop active until Riley Tanaka confirms resolution and reevaluation.

## State-changing send — Riley Tanaka

- Riley Tanaka approves only a frozen send-time audience with current, supported, and consistent governed state.
- Riley Tanaka requires preserved source evidence, named-owner certification where applicable, passed suppressions, release confirmation, and a required post-send audit.
- Changed, aged-out, unsupported, suppressed, or conflicting rows are removed or held; exceptions are not manually waived.
- Any final audience or template validation failure holds the whole send.
- A state change before release, customer correction, incident, or unresolved cross-surface discrepancy stops release and escalates to Riley Tanaka.

## Source and evidence checks — Owen Pham

- Owen Pham confirms required fields, named owners, certified-through dates, definitions, denominators, and evidence fields are complete and current.
- Owen Pham records visible incompleteness when required input or certification is missing; stale-data substitution is not permitted.
- Owen Pham escalates disputed semantics, missing required inputs, and cross-surface discrepancies to Riley Tanaka.

## Engineering release controls — Daniela Schultz

- Daniela Schultz owns integration release, transport, reliability, rollback, and restoration controls.
- Daniela Schultz approves connector-detection or release-behavior changes and coordinates rollback when required.
- Ines Kovac has no engineering release-control or rollback authority.
- No person releases, suppresses, restores, or rolls back an engineering-controlled path without Daniela Schultz’s control or an incident decision from Riley Tanaka.

## Required records

- Ines Kovac preserves the audience manifest, holds and suppressions, preflight evidence, release log, template output, audit result, and escalations.
- Owen Pham preserves source-completeness, denominator, owner-certification, and evidence-field records.
- Riley Tanaka’s decisions and Daniela Schultz’s release or rollback actions are recorded with the affected path, evidence, decision, and time.
